goalNotes: Your goals plan suggests new daily targets, about 1,960 kcal a day. You can take them on Today on the website, or in the latest app.

hydration.note: An estimate from your weight and the day's training, not a minimum. Thirst and pale urine are good everyday signs.

priorities.title: Complete your recovery picture
priorities.reason: Add energy and soreness so Coach can put your training in context.

priorities.title: Choose a session that fits today
priorities.reason: Review your programme and how you feel. A rest day can be part of your plan.

priorities.title: Log your first meal
priorities.reason: A photo or a short description is enough to start. Review portions before saving.

targetsProposal.title: New daily targets suggested
reasons: Your weight is about 63.1 kg now, above the 62 kg you aim to hold.
targetsProposal.followUp: These numbers are a starting estimate: from 2026-10-17, about 3 weeks on, Coach can check them against your weight trend with you.

energyCheck.title: Before a deficit: a few health questions
questions: Have you had a stress fracture in the last 2 years?
Have you had an eating disorder, or does eating often feel out of your control?
Have you missed a period, or had cycles longer than 35 days, in the last 3 months? (Skip this if you use hormonal contraception or gave birth in the last few months.)
energyCheck.note: Optional, and not a diagnosis. Only a yes or no and the date are kept, so the plan stays safe: with a yes it holds your weight instead, at about 2,300 kcal a day, and a sports doctor or sports dietitian can help you look into it.
